findings.description: The KMS key omits enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the key material protecting the logs bucket is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material widens the exposure window and blast radius if the key is ever compromised, and conflicts with common key-management baselines (CIS AWS 3.8).

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS applies the default key policy granting arn:aws:iam::<account>:root full control, which effectively delegates key usage and administration to any IAM principal in the account that can be granted kms:* via IAM. A least-privilege key policy should scope encrypt/decrypt and key administration to named principals.
